D02:120 ('type.num.base for every count and clock') and §6 L287 ('counts in type.num.base') ask for type.num.base; only the clocks are split here (k.clock_text, unlock_item()), as splitting counts is a kit-wide change (the kit's strip() title and the shared SCR-122 Save bar), not one board's.

strip.unlock_again takes the badge's danger tone: it counts down the same final minute (D3 L116: danger from 1:00; D4 L117: one tone for one event) (DJ)

The strip item's clock '0:59' is its own text node in type.num.base (D02:120 'type.num.base for every count and clock'; Appendix A L865), like the badge's: local helper unlock_item() swaps the kit strip_item()'s single type.ui.body text for k.clock_text(); the row's note carries the full string.
strip.unlock_again has no env badge: the admin window belongs to no slice (§4 L167-168 gives each strip item its slice's CMP-012 env badge)

Page: SH-3's row (§4 L183) names no page; the board keeps the page SH-1's row names, 'drawn over SCR-122 mid-edit' (L181), which SH-4 expires over ('while SCR-122 is dirty', L184) and D02:200 walks through ('The owner edits SCR-122 … At 1 min: assertive; the badge takes the danger tone'), with UD-3's role change manager → viewer (L386) as the edit, without its cap error (whose {n}, ud.cap_max, the worked example does not give): board 01's SCR-122 as boards 02 and 04 draw it, built with gen_02.py's builders (the same strings, sizes and focus), so boards 02 and 03 differ only in the badge and the strip and boards 01-04 read as one window's countdown over one edit (DJ).

SH-3 gates nothing, so every write is drawn enabled (T1), as on board 02: the role select, each grant's checkbox and level select (L405), Sign out this session (UD-15, L398), the Danger zone's Reset two-factor, Disable and Delete (L361; Tab order L405-406) and Save. At 0:00 SH-4 turns every write but Save T2 admin.locked and describes Save admin.locked (L184; D02:200), so boards 03 and 04 compare one to one.

SCR-122 content this state does not need is drawn as neutral placeholders, both values the spec does not give for alex (the e-mail, display name and last sign-in, sub_002's environment, the limit values, the session row's device, IP and times, the three audit rows) and the effective-permission inputs UD-2 (L385) and UD-18 (L401) give: color.surface.hover bars, radius.control (pills radius.badge); boards 43 (UD-2), 55, 56, 97 and 100 draw that content. They are not a loading state (UD-1 is board 42).

Focus is drawn on the Role select, the field being edited: §4 L200 and §13 L581 say focus never moves on expiry and name no control, and neither the 1:00 threshold nor the new strip item moves it, so the board shows it where the edit is (DJ), as boards 01, 02 and 04 do.

Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

A focus ring is a 2 px color.focus.ring inner stroke on a wrapper with space.inset.xs (4 px) padding, so it sits 2 px off the control (CMP-039) inside the wrapper's bounds; its radius is the next step (radius.card around radius.control); the wrapper adds 4 px on each side to the layout.

The Save bar is a raised card (radius.card, space.inset.lg) with the change summary at its start and Save at its end, as on boards 01, 02 and 04 (board choice: §8 L361-362 gives only 'change summary + Save').
